card: Adds a GetUnbroadcastTxCount() accessor to CTxMemPool and uses it in getmempoolinfo instead of copying the unbroadcast transaction ID set. Previously, reading unbroadcastcount via GetUnbroadcastTxs().size() copied all unbroadcast IDs by value under the mempool lock, discarding them immediately after checking the container size. The author's microbenchmarks show query time growing from 25 ns with 0 IDs up to ~0.9 ms with 10,000 IDs for the copy approach, compared to an approximately constant ~22.6 ns with the direct accessor.
evidence: Author microbenchmarks on Apple M5 show GetUnbroadcastTxs().size() query time scales from 25 ns at 0 entries to ~0.9 ms at 10,000 entries, while GetUnbroadcastTxCount() remains flat at ~22.6 ns.
problem: MempoolInfoToJSON called GetUnbroadcastTxs().size(), which returns the unbroadcast transaction ID set by value. For nodes with unbroadcast transactions, calling getmempoolinfo copied the set under the mempool lock and immediately discarded it.

risk.why: It introduces a read-only lock-guarded accessor for a container size and swaps an RPC read call, carrying minimal risk of regression.

summary: Adds a GetUnbroadcastTxCount() accessor to CTxMemPool and updates MempoolInfoToJSON to use it. This avoids copying the entire set of unbroadcast transaction IDs by value under lock merely to return its size for getmempoolinfo.
